placeholders.detail: {kind} select in close/next/position/previous; {index, number, ::group-off} and {count, number, ::group-off} in position and image_lightbox.asset_of; {medialabel} in image_lightbox.previous/next/close.

observations.issue: «Mục {index} / {count}» renders the English «Asset» as «Mục», while the same namespace's asset arms use «Tệp» (close «Đóng tệp», next «Tệp tiếp theo», position «Tệp … trên …», previous «Tệp trước»). This is a glossary split within one namespace: «Mục» is otherwise the locale's word for a section or goal (mục tiêu, mục thời gian), not an asset. The value is byte-identical to parent B (origin/main 91aa8f5f), whose vi canvas batch audit b928c7f0c96d passed it clean, so it is carried as approved and is not counted as a new finding here.
observations.recommendation: If a future copy pass touches this namespace, align to «Tệp …»; the minimal change is «Tệp {index, number, ::group-off} / {count, number, ::group-off}». Not counted: parent-approved unchanged value, re-bind scope.

observations.issue: The merged file is the exact union of the two audited parents. Parent A contributes the four select-form keys (close/next/position/previous) and the four shared keys; parent B contributes the four image_lightbox keys and the four shared keys. No value was overwritten, no key dropped, and the four shared values are identical in both parents.
